The '''Overseer of Prison Worlds''' was in charge of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], and the [[Confiscation Authority]].<ref name="JQ: TCotG" />

When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], as well as their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ferus Olin]], took on the identities of arrested members of the [[Slams|Slam gang]] as part of a plan to arrest [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], they needed to requisition the criminals' [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. They enlisted the aid of [[Tyro Caladian]], a [[senatorial aide]], who in turn had to get a waiver from the [[Senate Security Committee]] to meet with the Overseer of Prison Worlds. The Overseer of Prison Worlds then issued an order to the [[Confiscation Authority]] to allow the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to commandeer the Slams' ship, a [[Ubrikkian star yacht]].<ref name="JQ: TCotG" />
